column6: Record is null in InTheClassTheLineStated. Both call sites ask whether the record is null before calling, so the null check inside is one the caller has already made
SplitText's last string. An empty text returns before the loop, and every other text leaves its last rune in the builder, so the builder is never empty here
ParseKeyValues. equals is 0 only when the text starts with '=', which the loop skipped five lines earlier
UseCompression in RDataOf. Serialize is called with no offset table, and DomainName.Serialize starts a fresh empty one per name, so nothing is ever in it to point at
the same: position zero is unreachable here
the owner name of a record RDataOf has just serialized always ends in a root label, so the walk cannot reach the end of the buffer
UseCompression in ReadBackFromWire. The name is the first thing written into a fresh stream with an empty table

the class check after the RDATA. InTheClassTheLineStated reads a record in another class back through the wire form with the stated class, and TKEY and TSIG are built in it, so a record reaching this line is already in the class the line stated
TypeBitMapContains. A window header at the very end of the buffer carries no bitmap, so entering it and skipping it both end in false
DecodeTypeBitMaps. Entering the loop at the end of the bitmap breaks at the window-header check two lines below
DecodeTypeBitMaps. A window header with nothing behind it adds no types whether the loop leaves here or at the bitmap-length check
DecodeTypeBitMaps. 0x80 >> 8 is zero, so the ninth pass masks nothing and adds nothing
UseCompression in the owner rewrite: the new owner goes first, into an empty stream with an empty table
